title: Incremental implementation of the gameplay redesign

constraints.legacy_save_pack_policy: Version checks or explicit conversion; no unconditional backward-compatibility promise.

increments.title: Baseline and migration ledger
increments.completion: All catalogue entries mapped; current gameplay, performance and determinism evidence recorded; superseded future PASM choices identified.

increments.title: Explicit Consoles and ownership
increments.completion: Explicit Console identities and bindings preserve existing screens, joining, ratings, human seeking, Backfill and reconnect.

increments.title: Composable Systems and common status
increments.completion: Dock proves supported component composition and generic commands; common status/details covers manual, passive and delegated equipment.

increments.title: Reusable AI state trees
increments.completion: Dock proves one bounded-knowledge System controller with supported state trees, inheritance, references and Workshop editing.

increments.title: Common observations and reports
increments.completion: Existing observations retain access while gaining provenance, age, uncertainty, explicit feeds and repair reports.

increments.title: Shared jobs and team execution
increments.completion: Existing repair work runs through shared job/team execution with equivalent repair outcomes and report-driven work lists.

increments.title: Stores, transfers and service links
increments.completion: Existing ammunition, transfer and facility stock use shared capacities, inventories, reservations and explicit links; replenishment works.

increments.title: Shared mounts and configurable weapons
increments.completion: Existing phasers, blasters and torpedoes use common mounts, barrel patterns and delivery/effect machinery with equivalent combat behaviour.

increments.title: Power, batteries, coolant and heat
increments.completion: Local reserves, flow allocation, thermal state and selected flow cuts work with human/AI controls, complexity and replenishment.

increments.title: Shield energy and protection
increments.completion: Shield upkeep, recharge and battery-mediated redistribution use shared resources/conditions and remain independently usable.

increments.title: Decks, compartments and internal routes
increments.completion: Workshop authors layouts/materials/System placement; team travel uses shared routes and access boundaries before damage changes.

increments.title: Component damage and restoration
increments.completion: Compartment penetration and component conditions land together with structural/component repair, parts use, disablement and recovery.

increments.title: Automatic logistics and production
increments.completion: Stock targets, timed delivery, fabrication and surviving salvage use real stores, jobs and routes; optional harvesting stays bounded.

increments.title: Equipment fitting and refitting
increments.completion: Compatible field/facility refits and favourites use actual equipment/resource/work limits and shared Workshop definitions.

increments.title: Sensing and environmental interaction
increments.completion: Independent scanners, passive/history/uncertainty/correlation and shared radars use upgraded regions, signal attenuation and terrain occlusion.

increments.title: Layered combat
increments.completion: Interception, longer-range missiles, broadsides, guidance, payloads and optional shield probing support multiple viable styles.

increments.title: Shared Comms channels and remote orders
increments.completion: Human/AI channels, generic requests, public chatter, security/interception, relays, receipts and human media use existing networking without message-capacity accounting.

increments.title: Electronic operations
increments.completion: Jamming, spoofing, protection, concealment and bounded disruption reuse mounts/signals/resources/conditions and expose known/friendly effects.

increments.title: Movement and transit extensions
increments.completion: Direct/assisted motion, Match Speed, formation/docking and jump/transit preserve the capital/small-craft dimensional split.

increments.title: Ordinary deployables and carried craft
increments.completion: Configured entities plus deployment/sortie/recovery work support probes, turrets, decoys, fighters, shuttles and drones with ordinary autonomous/link-loss behaviour.

increments.title: Broader personnel operations
increments.completion: Duty Officers, medical/security/boarding/away/transfer work reuses team/jobs and supports rescue, abandonment and capture participation.

increments.title: Facilities and systemic outside actors
increments.completion: Facilities, workforce and actor objectives use common equipment/damage/teams/stocks/physical delivery and causal service dependencies.

increments.title: Authored mission planning, scheduling and execution
increments.completion: Reusable activity contracts, partial-order HTN domains and crew-aware temporal scheduling execute through independent situations, Scenario trees and ordinary jobs. Authored missions support sequential or concurrent work, committed deadlines, plan repair and Workshop inspection.

increments.title: Continuing modes and persistent mission consequences
increments.completion: Authored Patrol, then War, then Sandbox retain real assets, commitments and consequences across encounters. Capture, service, vessel return and evacuation prove persistence, actual transport, outside-actor outcomes and correct objective credit.

increments.title: Opportunity discovery, adaptive direction and final integration
increments.completion: Bounded GOAP-like search combines existing activity operators around authored goals, admitting feasible optional opportunities into HTN missions. Adapt unannounced work within pacing bounds; preserve commitments and earned advantages. Complete planetary, catalogue, Workshop and 2/4/6/8-seat audits.

provisional_items.rule: Do not implement lossy used-coolant recycling without a later recorded selection.

superseded_future_choices.old: Ship-wide hard battery exhaustion and primary percentage System damage.
superseded_future_choices.new: Local energy reserves, actual flow cuts, thermal/coolant constraints; component restoration follows increment 11.

superseded_future_choices.old: One mutually exclusive wide/focused scan axis.
superseded_future_choices.new: Independent broad and focused scanner Systems with separate power demand.
Static planets/moons/satellites/asteroid fields; movement does not imply orbit.

superseded_future_choices.old: Refitting only at starbases and battery-exhaustion fitting budget.
superseded_future_choices.new: Compatible field work and facility refits, constrained by actual resources and work; no additional abstract fitting currency.
